description: Rigid transform from the motion-capture frame (mocap_base) to the workbench world frame, one entry per calibration session. Each entry is the pose of mocap_base expressed in world: p_world = R(quaternion) p_mocap_base + translation, with the quaternion in xyzw order. Every demonstration folder must be processed with the calibration that was in force when it was recorded; 'datasets' records that mapping.

2026-06-01.source: hand-eye calibration of the motion-capture frame against the UR3e base

2026-07-27.source: hand-eye calibration against the FR3 base, composed with the world-to-FR3-base transform
